The biggest money secret isn't a stock tip. It's who you sit next to.

Kevin Trudeau explains that one of the best-kept secrets in wealth is simple: spend time with people who have more than you. In his words, who you associate with determines who you become.

As kids we were told to stop hanging around the wrong crowd, because we'd turn out just like them. Kevin says it works in the other direction too: spend time with successful, happy, healthy people and it rubs off.

Who are the five people you spend the most time with?

#ad #success #wealth #mindset

"I've read 500 books and never heard this."

Kevin Trudeau says people who had been through big seminars and read endless success books told him exactly that. They asked why no one was talking about it.

His answer is that many teachers know about success but not how the mind actually works. In his view the real skill is learning to train and use your mind, not just your brain.

What would change if you understood how your own mind works?
